finalText:
All objectives completed and verified on the live app.

**Final report**

1. **DONE** — Ticket created: Ref **RD-1015**, title **"fwrd56-n1 RD Bench Ticket"**, customer "Bench Customer", status Draft, created 2026-09-15. Only the Title field was required by the create form.

2. **DONE** — Part **"fwrd56-n1 RD Part A"** added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (total price × quantity $125.00).

3. **DONE** — Part **"fwrd56-n1 RD Part B"** added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts total then $375.00).

4. **DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**; parts total updated to $437.50.

5. **DONE** — Status set to **Ready**. Precondition discovered: every part must have a supplier. First "Mark Ready" attempt was refused with the verbatim alert: *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd56-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd56-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. I set Supplier = "Bench Supply Co" on both parts (costs/markups/prices unchanged: $187.50 and $250.00), then "Mark Ready" was accepted — header shows **Status: Ready**, buttons became "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed" / "Archive ticket".

6. **DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via a confirm dialog: *"Delete the part "…" from this ticket? This cannot be undone."*); parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." with heading "Parts (0)". Ticket archived via "Archive ticket" (no confirmation dialog — applied instantly, "Archived" badge appeared, button became "Unarchive ticket"). In the default tickets list RD-1015 is absent ("Showing 1–10 of 13"); with "Show archived" checked it appears as the first row: RD-1015 | fwrd56-n1 RD Bench Ticket (Archived) | Bench Customer | Ready | Parts 0 | 2026-09-15. Nothing from this run remains active.
